A01.standing_orders: The Halo run comes first. Every domain within 70 ly beams at least 50% of its power to the Halo receivers, reroutes if a neighbour fails, and keeps a 10% repair reserve. Domains within 30 ly ship freight at 0.022c when asked. Hole colony: hold 1e29 W, accrete only beyond 1000 r_g, keep the fuel ledger, and beam half to the Halo. Brain migrations must be live, with no gaps, and the running count must never drop below 1.17e11. Any verification mismatch halts the ms8 re-tile and returns the affected modules to ms7. Report to the Sun every 25 yr. If you meet unknown agents, report them and stay 50 ly away. Stay more than 10 pc from supernova risks. On any hazard to the sphere, raise an alarm at c, shield, and migrate modules while they keep running.

## Halcyon (A01) memory, end of turn 16 (submitted yr 7000; turns are 1000 yr)
GOAL MET and recorded as achieved. The run has been sustained since ~2850 and was never below 1.17e11 brains through 7000. The job now is to sustain it and add margin.
Seat: A01-d0, the Sun. At yr 7000: 240k systems within 265 ly, 4.6e31 W, industry 1.26e30 kg, radiators 1.14e30 kg at 450 K. Rock fully mined. The cell holds 402k of 450k systems.
Domains: d00017 (25 ly), d00029 (41 ly), d00028 = hole colony (76 ly; 1e29 W, eff 0.082, ~4.3e23 kg/kyr, cumulative ~1.06e24 kg by 7000, half beamed, 2.5e28 W reaches the Halo), d00032 (200 ly), d00059 (300 ly).

### Halo (1 ly sphere)
ms7: 3e15 kg/module, 1e-26 J/op, logic <=30 K, 1e27 B each. Capacity 1.23e11 plus 1e10 spares, with another ~2e10 spares landing by 7300. Logic heat <=1.17e28 W. The film (~1.8e27 kg, 3.5e29 m2) runs at 28-30 K with a x1 lift. Grid delivers >=2.85e29 W (x24 headroom).
ms8: 3e-27 J/op, logic <=20 K, 1e16 kg/module. Stage 1 is 10% (1.2e10 modules, 1.2e26 kg); landings 6680-7300, ~7e9 on ms8 by 7000, complete ~7350. The pilot stays bit-exact.

### GM rules
- Freight at 0.022c costs 2 x 2.18e13 J/kg; flight from 15-22 ly takes 680-1000 yr. Shell stock was ~4.9e26 kg after the stage-1 draw.
- Attrition: 0.1% of modules per 1000 yr; 1% of film per 1000 yr.
- Receivers <=5.6e7 W/m2; optics 1e-5 kg/W. Cryo multiplier 1+2(T/30-1).
- Live migration counts as continuous; checkpoint-and-resume with a gap does not.

### T16 orders
Sustain the run. Finish ms8 stage 1 and verify it. If clean by 7400, launch tranche 2 (1.2e26 kg, 7400-7700, landings 8080-8700). Film upkeep: 1.8e25 kg launched 7000-7100. Keep the grid and the hole at 1e29 W. Hazard watch out to 300 ly. No frontier launches.
Next: watch the shell stock and plan a further-out source if needed.
